text.arabic_uthmani: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle that keeps the clause inside the jinn's serial testimony while opening the former-listening memory
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the ayah begin as continuation within the jinn's own witness-list, not as detached cosmological exposition. It carries the previous discovery of the guarded sky into a retrospective explanation of how access used to work. The particle can also feel resumptive: the speech remains continuous, but the subtopic turns from what the sky was found to contain to the old practice of occupying listening posts.

topics.headline: continued witness-list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the former-listening report as one more item in the jinn's cumulative testimony rather than a narrator's detached aside.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a conjunction, and the attachment evidence keeps the clause within the continuing first-person speech sequence.

topics.headline: backgrounded access memory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the old sitting habit is background for understanding the new guarded sky, while the bound particle still opens a fresh explanatory beat.
topics.reason: The conjunction supports both continuity and a new coordinated statement, so the row's retrospective force is locally coherent.

words.gloss_range: subordinating particle plus first-person plural pronoun, packaging the former practice as reported collective testimony

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accepted emphatic variant reading for the same first-person plural testimony frame

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّا}} ({{tr:annā}}) packages the whole old-practice clause as content in the jinn's report while immediately marking the speakers as a collective. The memory is not a slogan standing on its own; it is a governed testimony-unit: we used to occupy those posts. The accepted emphatic reading with {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) does not change the event, but it shows how the same memory can be heard either as embedded report-content or as direct emphatic assertion.

topics.headline: reported proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the old listening practice as a single governed content-unit inside the larger jinn declaration.
topics.reason: QAC parses the word as a subordinating particle with a first-person plural pronoun, and the attachment evidence makes the following past-habit clause its predicate content.

topics.headline: variant assertion contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the event remains the same while the accepted reading contrast tunes whether the memory feels embedded or emphatically asserted.
topics.reason: The local surface licenses embedded content; the variant evidence is useful for discourse force but does not replace the canonical parse.

topics.headline: communal confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the former practice is owned by the speaking group before the ayah later generalizes to whoever attempts it now.
topics.reason: The first-person plural suffix is explicit in the local particle form and continues the jinn speakers' discourse reference.

words.gloss_range: past auxiliary establishing a former repeated state when joined to the imperfect action
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, and constituted state; here locally narrowed to former collective statehood in a past habitual construction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperfect predicate completing the past habitual construction
present time adverb that marks the regime break

words.prose: {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}) makes the sitting a former inhabited condition, not a single past incident. Joined to {{ar:نَقْعُدُ}} ({{tr:naqʿudu}}), it stretches the action into repeated habit and then seals that habit as past, which makes {{ar:ٱلْءَانَ}} ({{tr:al-ʾāna}}) a real regime break. The first-person plural suffix keeps the old condition collectively owned by the speakers. Wider {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) echoes of constitution and divine actuality (2:117; 36:82) can sharpen the contrast, but locally the active payoff is the former creaturely access-state now overridden.

topics.headline: former repeated state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the old access was a repeated condition now closed off, not one failed attempt.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the perfect auxiliary plus imperfect predicate as a past habitual frame.

topics.headline: collective inhabited condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the speakers as a group inhabiting an access-condition whose reality has changed.
topics.reason: The local form carries first-person plural agreement and the root field supports statehood without requiring a separate subject noun.

topics.headline: constituted-access coloring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can sense the old practice as an ordered access-state, while the local form remains the simple former-being auxiliary.
topics.reason: Non-surface derived and divine-actuality branches can color the contrast but cannot govern the local parse, which remains past habitual statehood.

topics.headline: before-now reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a whole former order being set up before the present conditional rule replaces it.
topics.reason: The local temporal contrast between the past habitual frame and the later present adverb supports the before-and-after discourse structure.

words.gloss_range: habitual sitting or remaining, locally functioning as purposeful emplacement for access
words.root_gloss_range: sitting, remaining, staying back, stationing, and base-like stability; here narrowed to self-occupied listening emplacement

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: place-noun echo of the sitting verb, naming the listening posts

words.prose: {{ar:نَقْعُدُ}} ({{tr:naqʿudu}}) keeps the old action ongoing inside the past auxiliary: they used to sit, remain, and occupy positions. In this context the root's bodily sitting becomes strategic stationing, because the action is directed toward hearing; unlike staying-back uses in 9:46 and 9:83, stillness here becomes active intrusion through its purpose. The first-person plural form makes the practice a communal habit before the later singular whoever-rule. Its echo with {{ar:مَقَٰعِدَ}} ({{tr:maqāʿida}}) makes act and site reinforce each other: the sitting produces listening infrastructure that will be answered by watchful counter-stationing.

topics.headline: ongoing past sitting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices unrestricted former habit before the later jussive conditional marks the current rule.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb is governed by the past auxiliary and contrasts grammatically with the later jussive conditional verbs.

topics.headline: posture as emplacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees stillness turned into purposeful occupation for unauthorized access, while the local form remains simple Form I sitting.
topics.reason: The purpose complement licenses strategic emplacement, while non-surface derived settling imagery is kept as root-family pressure rather than morphology.

topics.headline: self-occupied communal action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the jinn confess their own communal emplacement before the ayah universalizes the case to any individual intruder.
topics.reason: The actual Form I first-person plural verb supports self-occupied action and does not introduce causative or associative sitting-with semantics.

topics.headline: act-site echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the act of sitting and the listening posts as one infrastructure of intrusion before the countermeasure arrives.
topics.reason: The repeated root in the verb and place-noun is local and directly visible in the ayah.

topics.headline: stillness as intrusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sitting is not morally neutral here; purpose turns staying still into active intrusion, unlike staying-back uses in 9:46 and 9:83.
topics.reason: The local purpose phrase determines the force of the sitting, while the cited cross-references provide a controlled contrast for the root's ethical range.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus feminine pronoun referring back to the sky, with from/within/partitive spatial pressure
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهَا}} ({{tr:minhā}}) carries the sky from 72:8 into the new clause without renaming it. The feminine suffix makes the ayah boundary structurally necessary: the former listening posts belong to the same sky just described as filled with guards and flames. The preposition lets the relation feel like from, within, or part of that domain, so the old access is not distant observation but an incursion into the guarded zone whose access history is now being explained.

topics.headline: same sky carried over
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps 72:8's sky active as the location of the former listening infrastructure.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the feminine suffix as referring back to the sky from 72:8.

topics.headline: within the guarded domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the old posts as spatially invasive within the same celestial domain, not merely oriented toward it from afar.
topics.reason: The preposition and pronoun complement attach to the sitting verb and license source, partitive, or locative pressure.

topics.headline: discovery becomes access history
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah boundary turn the sky from a found object into the domain whose former access is explained.
topics.reason: The pronoun depends on the preceding ayah, so the transition from discovery to explanation is structurally encoded.

words.gloss_range: plural place-noun for sitting stations, locally the mapped posts of the old listening practice
words.root_gloss_range: sitting, place of sitting, foundations, fixed stations; here narrowed to multiple organized listening posts

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: singular indefinite flame that answers the plural listening posts

words.prose: {{ar:مَقَٰعِدَ}} ({{tr:maqāʿida}}) turns the old habit into mapped locations. It is not merely that they sat; the plural place-noun makes the practice an infrastructure of stations. The foundation-like field of {{ar:ق ع د}} ({{tr:q-ʿ-d}}) can color the posts as fixed supports, while the local grammar keeps the active sense to place-noun stationing. The same place logic can mark legitimate nearness in 54:55, but here it names illicit listening posts. The plural posts then face the later singular {{ar:شِهَابًۭا}} ({{tr:shihāban}}): organized access is answered by a repeatable individual interceptor.

topics.headline: mapped sitting locations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the old sitting is localized in defined positions rather than left as bare posture.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the word as an accusative place expression related to the sitting verb and purpose phrase.

topics.headline: stations as infrastructure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the repeated sitting objectified into a network of posts, with foundation imagery as local coloring rather than a separate lexical sense.
topics.reason: The noun-of-place form licenses stationing; foundation-field rows are kept as supporting color because the surface is the place-noun for posts.

topics.headline: multiple posts, one interceptor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a distributed old access network is collapsed by the rule that any current listener meets a single repeatable flame.
topics.reason: The local plural place-noun contrasts directly with the later singular indefinite object.

topics.headline: sitting-post echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the verb and place-noun mutually define the intrusion, while 54:55 supplies a contrast between legitimate and illicit stationing.
topics.reason: The root echo is local, and the cited occurrence at 54:55 provides a concrete contrast for station legitimacy without controlling the local parse.

words.gloss_range: purposive or designating preposition binding the stations to the hearing objective
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) assigns the stations their purpose: they are for hearing. Because the phrase can attach to both the sitting act and the place-noun, the purpose saturates action and infrastructure at once. The bound form fuses that purpose directly to the definite hearing noun, so the old offense is not accidental nearness to sound but intentional stationing for a known auditory channel.

topics.headline: hearing as stated purpose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sitting and stations are intentional arrangements for hearing, not accidental proximity.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the preposition as purposive, and attachment evidence links the hearing phrase to the station frame.

topics.headline: purpose over act and station
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hearing as the function of both what the jinn did and the places they occupied.
topics.reason: The local syntax allows the purpose phrase to reinforce both the verb and the place-noun without forcing a single exclusive attachment.

topics.headline: bound designated use
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form makes hearing the named assigned use of the stations in one compact phrase.
topics.reason: The proclitic preposition and definite noun form a single bound purpose phrase in the local surface.

words.gloss_range: definite verbal noun for hearing, locally a known auditory information-channel sought by the old stations
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, listening, auditory reception, received report, and divine all-hearing; here narrowed to a creaturely channel of protected information

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later Form X listening attempt from the same hearing root

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمْعِ}} ({{tr:al-samʿi}}) names hearing as a definite target-domain, not generic sound. The point of the stations is access to a known channel of received information. The same root then returns in {{ar:يَسْتَمِعِ}} ({{tr:yastamiʿi}}), so the noun first names the desired channel and the later verb turns that channel into a present attempted breach. Against legitimate Qur'an-hearing in 72:1 and the divine all-hearing field, the local word stays a definite verbal noun for bounded creaturely audition under surveillance.

topics.headline: known auditory channel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the jinn sought a recognized channel of information, not mere acoustic sensation.
topics.reason: The definite verbal noun after the purpose preposition supports a known hearing-domain, and the root field includes received report as well as hearing.

topics.headline: purpose becomes trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same hearing-root move from old purpose to present punishable attempt.
topics.reason: The root recurs locally in the purpose noun and the later Form X verb, creating the channel-to-breach progression.

topics.headline: bounded creaturely audition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place the old sky-listening against both legitimate Qur'an-hearing in 72:1 and bounded creaturely audition under the divine all-hearing field.
topics.reason: The stealth and divine-hearing fields are relevant contrasts, but the local surface remains the definite hearing verbal noun rather than a stealth verb or divine epithet.

words.gloss_range: consequential-resumptive particle opening the current whoever-condition from the former access setup

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: conditional whoever introducing the present rule

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) pivots from remembered habit to present rule. It opens a complete conditional clause rather than merely adding another predicate to the old past frame. Bound to {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}), it makes the rule arrive immediately: given the former posts and the newly guarded sky, whoever listens now meets the prepared consequence.

topics.headline: new governed condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a new conditional unit beginning, not a continuation of the old past predicate.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence separates the conditional protasis and apodosis from the earlier past habitual clause.

topics.headline: past setup to live result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the present rule as a consequence branched from the old access practice and the guarded-sky discovery.
topics.reason: The particle's local position between past habit and present conditional supports a temporal-consequential pivot.

topics.headline: bound whoever-rule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that consequence and generalization arrive as one compact surface move.
topics.reason: The proclitic form binds the particle directly to the conditional pronoun.

words.gloss_range: conditional-relative whoever, opening a reusable profile for any rational listener
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) changes the frame from the speakers' collective memory to an open whoever-rule. It governs the listening attempt and the finding-result as one reusable conditional sequence. The singular masculine agreement then builds a generic listener profile: whoever chooses the act becomes the one to whom the consequence is assigned.

topics.headline: whoever enters the rule
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the new boundary applying beyond the reporting jinn to any rational intruder.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as conditional or relative, introducing an indefinite participant rather than a named antecedent.

topics.headline: attempt and result bound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the listening attempt and the flame encounter belong to one grammatical rule.
topics.reason: The conditional pronoun governs the protasis and apodosis sequence in the local syntax.

topics.headline: conduct-defined agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that identity is defined by the act of listening, compressed into a reusable singular profile after the plural confession.
topics.reason: The following singular verbs and pronoun resume the conditional participant and form a generic conduct-based profile.

words.gloss_range: Form X jussive listening attempt, locally active pursuit of a protected hearing channel
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, listening, seeking to hear, giving ear, and stealthy audition in related forms; here narrowed to deliberate attempted listening under a conditional rule

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: jussive result verb answering the listening protasis

words.prose: {{ar:يَسْتَمِعِ}} ({{tr:yastamiʿi}}) is the conditional trigger. Its jussive form binds the attempt to the result in {{ar:يَجِدْ}} ({{tr:yajid}}), and the final vowel does not cancel that mood. As Form X, it makes the act deliberate pursuit of hearing rather than accidental reception. Eavesdropping scenes in 15:18 and 37:10 sharpen that protected-channel setting, while the local form keeps the meaning to sought listening rather than a different stealth morphology.

topics.headline: attempt triggers result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the listening attempt itself activates the rule leading to the flame encounter.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the verb as jussive protasis governed by the conditional pronoun.

topics.headline: deliberate sought audition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the offense as active pursuit of protected hearing, while the local morphology stops short of making a different stealth form the surface meaning.
topics.reason: Form X licenses seeking or attempted audition; stealth-listening derivatives support contextual pressure but do not replace the surface form.

topics.headline: stolen-hearing scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the same hearing-and-flame system known from 15:18 and 37:10, now spoken from the intruders' perspective.
topics.reason: The supplied inter-ayah evidence gives concrete eavesdropping contexts where hearing is paired with the pursuing flame.

topics.headline: old purpose restaged
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the old hearing-purpose return as an immediate present attempt with no room for successful access.
topics.reason: The same root appears in the earlier purpose phrase and here in the present protasis, with the time adverb and result verb adjacent.

words.gloss_range: definite time adverb marking the live present as the break between former access and current enforcement
words.root_gloss_range: time, present moment, due or proper time; here narrowed to the decisive now of changed access

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: past auxiliary marking the former habitual state
result verb after the present time adverb

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْءَانَ}} ({{tr:al-ʾāna}}) is the ayah's temporal hinge. It modifies the listening attempt itself, so the same kind of act is reclassified because it happens now, after the sky has been found guarded. Its definite adverbial force makes the present a rupture-point between {{ar:كُنَّا}} ({{tr:kunnā}}) and {{ar:يَجِدْ}} ({{tr:yajid}}). Broader due-time and rare-now evidence strengthens the sense of a decisive boundary, while the local payoff remains the immediate present enforcement.

topics.headline: now as regime break
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that time itself has changed the status of the listening attempt from former possibility to current interception.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the word as the time adverb modifying the present listening attempt.

topics.headline: due-time coloring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can sense the enforcement as a live ordered moment, while the local word still functions as the concrete now-adverb.
topics.reason: Due-time and live-state fields support coloring but should not expand the local adverb beyond its temporal hinge function.

topics.headline: marked decisive present
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the rare decisive now as the point where the guarded-sky discovery of 72:8 becomes an operative rule.
topics.reason: The distributional rows support decisive time-statement force, and the 72:8 reference anchors the boundary locally.

words.gloss_range: jussive finding in the apodosis, locally encountering an already prepared defense
words.root_gloss_range: finding, discovering, coming upon, and experiencing; here narrowed to the listener's encounter with a prepared flame
words.prose: {{ar:يَجِدْ}} ({{tr:yajid}}) answers the listening protasis, so the flame is not a possible accident but the rule-bound result of the attempt. The same generic listener remains the subject: whoever seeks hearing is the one who finds the consequence assigned to him. The simple Form I keeps the defense independent of the listener; he does not create it, he comes upon what is already waiting. The verb also reverses the quest: he seeks sound and finds fire, moving discovery from the collective sky-finding of 72:8 into personal consequence.

topics.headline: rule-bound result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the finding of the flame is the grammatical consequence of attempted listening.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the verb as the jussive apodosis whose implicit subject is controlled by the conditional participant.

topics.headline: finding what waits
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the listener encountering an already prepared defense, with inward consequence possible but not replacing the external object found.
topics.reason: Form I finding and the direct object support encounter with a prepared presence; broader inward-experience range is retained as pressure, not as a replacement for the object encounter.

topics.headline: collective discovery to personal consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices discovery moving from the jinn's collective finding in 72:8 to the individual listener's finding in 72:9.
topics.reason: The same-surah co-occurrence and discourse rows anchor the discovery motif in the immediate 72:8-72:9 boundary.

topics.headline: seeking sound, finding fire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the epistemic quest reverse into an encounter with guarded force.
topics.reason: The local sequence moves from the listening verb to finding the flame phrase, supporting the reversal from sought sound to encountered fire.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus pronoun assigning or directing the found flame to the conditional listener

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: flame object personalized by the prepositional pronoun
conditional participant resumed by the suffix pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) personalizes the consequence. The pronoun returns to {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}), so the same one who attempts listening is the one for whom, or against whom, the flame is found. The lām-form can look like assignment or benefit, but the context turns it hostile: the interceptor is specifically appointed to the listener. Its placement before {{ar:شِهَابًۭا}} ({{tr:shihāban}}) establishes that personal relation before the object is named.

topics.headline: flame appointed to listener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the flame is not merely present but assigned to the would-be listener as a hostile consequence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence allows dative or adversative relation, and the surrounding flame-result context gives the assignment hostile force.

topics.headline: same generic listener resumed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same generic intruder from condition through result without needing the person renamed.
topics.reason: The pronoun suffix is syntactically tied to the conditional participant.

topics.headline: relation before object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the listener's relation to the interceptor before the flame itself is named.
topics.reason: The prepositional pronoun precedes the object in the local word order and compresses the target relation into one form.

words.gloss_range: indefinite concrete flame or meteor-like projectile, locally narrowed to a repeatable celestial interceptor
words.root_gloss_range: flame, blazing body, meteor-streak, brightness, and ash-gray residue; here narrowed to a concrete celestial defensive flame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: watch-state qualifier that turns the flame into a sentinel

words.prose: {{ar:شِهَابًۭا}} ({{tr:shihāban}}) names the object the listener finds: a concrete flame or meteor-like interceptor, not an abstract prohibition. Its indefiniteness makes it repeatable, a class of available watch-flames rather than one named projectile. Because 72:8 has already mentioned plural fiery bodies filling the sky, the singular here individualizes that field for whoever listens now. The same flame term belongs to anti-eavesdropping scenes at 15:18, 37:10, and 67:5, and 72:9 voices that system from the denied listener's side. The object appears before {{ar:رَّصَدًۭا}} ({{tr:raṣadan}}), so visible fire is first perceived and then revealed as watchful purpose.

topics.headline: repeatable found flame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fiery interception is the direct object found, and its indefiniteness makes the encounter repeatable for any listener.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as an indefinite accusative object qualified by the following indefinite descriptor.

topics.headline: flame as celestial defense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a visible celestial projectile functioning as defense, while broader firebrand and ash-color fields remain supportive color rather than the full local sense.
topics.reason: The immediate sky context and prior plural fiery bodies narrow the concrete noun toward a celestial interceptor; derivative color fields are retained only as secondary resonance.

topics.headline: filled sky individualized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the collective defense of 72:8 distributed into the individual interceptor found by any present listener.
topics.reason: The row's plural-to-singular contrast is anchored in the 72:8-72:9 boundary and the local singular indefinite object.

topics.headline: anti-eavesdropping usage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the flame as part of the Quranic anti-eavesdropping scenes at 15:18, 37:10, and 67:5.
topics.reason: The supplied occurrence evidence gives concrete anti-eavesdropping contexts for the same flame term.

topics.headline: phenomenon becomes sentinel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first sees the fiery object, then recognizes through the following word that the phenomenon is functioning as surveillance.
topics.reason: The local order places the flame before its watch-state qualifier, supporting the shift from visible object to guarded function.

words.gloss_range: accusative verbal noun functioning as qualifier or state, making the flame watchful and lying in wait
words.root_gloss_range: watching, monitoring, lying in wait, watch-post, ambush, and prepared readiness; here narrowed to the flame's surveillance function
words.prose: {{ar:رَّصَدًۭا}} ({{tr:raṣadan}}) seals the ayah by turning the visible flame into a watchful function. Whether taken as descriptor or state, the verbal noun makes the flame defined by readiness, not simply by brightness. The root's watch-post and ambush field answers the earlier listening posts: the jinn had stations for hearing, and the flame is stationed for watching. Wider watch-post language in 78:21 and 89:14 strengthens the monitored-ambush field, while locally the final word gives the sentence its surveillance closure.

topics.headline: fire in watch-mode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the flame is not bare fire; it is defined by watchful readiness at the ayah's close.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence parse the word as an accusative verbal noun qualifying the flame, either as adjective or state.

topics.headline: prepared surveillance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the barrier as organized watchful ambush, while readiness branches remain supporting pressure on the local verbal noun.
topics.reason: The root field supports watching and lying in wait; derived readiness evidence sharpens but does not replace the local verbal noun descriptor.

topics.headline: guard post answers listening posts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the ayah as a contest between stationed access and stationed surveillance.
topics.reason: The earlier place-noun for listening posts and the final surveillance noun form a local reciprocal stationing pattern.

topics.headline: wider watch-post language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this sky defense within the wider Quranic language of monitored ambush at 78:21 and 89:14.
topics.reason: The supplied occurrence evidence anchors the watch-post field in concrete references without making those references govern the local parse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ق ع د in نَقْعُدُ ... مَقَاعِدَ fixes repeated listening at prepared seats, while رَصَدًا makes the encountered flame itself watchful.
baseline_models.mechanism: The listeners occupy stable posts and lie in wait for sound; the bright flame reverses their tactic by functioning as a guard already lying in wait for each new listener.

activation_trace.role: Sitting and being fixed in a place supplies the durable listening station.
Sitting in watch or ambush casts the listeners as covert watchers.
Auditory perception supplies the sought material at those stations.
A bright flame supplies the mobile countermeasure met by the listener.
Watching and guarding turns the flame into a counter-watcher rather than an accidental projectile.

changed_reading.before: A listener happens to be struck by a meteor.
changed_reading.after: A covert listening infrastructure has been met by a mirrored counter-ambush: the watchers now find a luminous watcher waiting for them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كُنَّا marks the former habitual arrangement, while ٱلْـَٔانَ and the conditional فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ shift the sentence to a current rule.
baseline_models.mechanism: A previously stable practice is converted into a newly operative access rule: any present attempt predictably encounters a countermeasure prepared for that attempt.

activation_trace.role: Temporal occurrence and predication locate the listening practice in a former state.
Fixed sitting makes that former state habitual and infrastructural rather than momentary.
Encountering or coming upon something supplies the reliable result of a present attempt.
Preparation or setting aside makes the flame an allocated response under the new rule.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports one defensive incident.
changed_reading.after: The ayah announces a protocol change from formerly available stations to a present distributive rule in which each attempt has a response reserved for it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence لِلسَّمْعِ ... يَسْتَمِعِ repeats the hearing root as both the station's purpose and the intruder's deliberate act.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sought commodity can be understood as intelligible uptake, not bare acoustic sensation; the prepared flame blocks conversion of overheard sound into actionable understanding.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and responsive compliance expand hearing from sound reception to meaningful uptake.
Lying in wait supplies the deliberate extraction posture directed at that uptake.
A prepared response blocks the extraction attempt at the point of access.

changed_reading.before: The stations are places for catching sounds.
changed_reading.after: The stations are an attempted intelligence interface, and the new defense interrupts acquisition of usable meaning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies a different information path: concealed knowledge is delivered, heard as recitation, recognized as guidance, and settled into trust. This revises the focus blockade from hostility to hearing as such into a rerouting from interception to authorized reception.

activation_trace.role: Meaningful uptake anchors the focus attempt as a bid for usable understanding.
Ambush-like sitting marks the focus mode as covert acquisition.
Knowledge cast in concealment supplies a legitimate hidden-to-disclosed transfer.
Understanding and compliance make the reported hearing transformative rather than extractive.
Reading and recitation supply the public, formed object through which the knowledge is received.
Gentle direction to the road and truth gives the received discourse an orienting function.
Straightness of path supplies the destination of that orientation.
Heart-settling assent supplies the receiver's answer to the authorized message.

structural_cues: 72:1-2 moves from revelation to listening, recitation, guidance, and belief before 72:9 returns to listening stations.
The same hearing lexeme participates in both the accepted message sequence and the blocked interception sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed delivery, recitation, guidance, and settled assent; I infer that these form the permitted alternative to stationed interception. A live alternative is that 72:1-2 describes the message's effects without directly defining the reason for the later blockade.

changed_reading.before: Heaven has become inaccessible to listeners.
changed_reading.after: Access to knowledge has been rerouted: covert listeners are excluded while disclosed recitation remains hearable and capable of guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah turns the focus encounter into the edge behavior of a filled defensive field: active probing reaches a heaven saturated with strong guards and plural flames, while 72:9 distributes one waiting flame to each current listener.

activation_trace.role: Fixed seats locate the attempted access points within the boundary system.
Watching and guarding make the singular flame the local response of that system.
Seeking and probing make the approach an active boundary test.
Filling to the capacity of a container turns defense from an isolated object into saturation.
Preservation and guarding supply the defensive personnel or function across the field.
Strength and solidity intensify the boundary's resistance.
Plural bright flames supply the inventory from which the focus encounter is distributed.

structural_cues: 72:8 immediately precedes the focus and uses plural guards and flames; 72:9 shifts to a singular flame under a whoever-listens conditional.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies probing, fullness, guards, strength, and plural flames; I infer a layered perimeter whose local rule assigns a response to each attempt. Fullness could instead be emphatic abundance rather than a literal architecture.

changed_reading.before: A single flame reacts to a single trespass.
changed_reading.after: Each flame encounter is the individualized edge response of a saturated, strongly guarded perimeter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers can report the new defense but explicitly deny knowledge of whether harm is intended for earth's inhabitants or their Lord wills guidance. The flame therefore proves denied access without transparently disclosing the system's wider purpose.

activation_trace.role: The bright flame supplies the observable enforcement event.
Preparation makes the enforcement deliberate but does not itself disclose its larger intention.
Knowledge and discernment, explicitly negated here, impose an epistemic limit on interpreting the event.
Evil or harm supplies one live interpretation of the changed boundary.
Will and intention frame both alternatives while leaving the intended one unresolved for the speakers.

structural_cues: 72:10 follows the focus report with an explicit لا ندري and an evil-or-guidance disjunction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an observed countermeasure and confessed uncertainty about intention; I infer that the former cannot be treated as a transparent sign of the latter. The uncertainty may concern consequences on earth more broadly rather than the immediate function of the flame.

changed_reading.before: The waiting flame straightforwardly announces punitive hostility.
changed_reading.after: The waiting flame certifies a changed access rule, while the reporters remain unable to decode whether its wider purpose portends harm or guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Plural, divided paths do not provide a workaround: the speakers say they cannot outstrip control on earth or by flight, and the later repeated finding construction denies a side refuge. The blocked listening seat becomes one checkpoint within jurisdiction that extends across routes and escape strategies.

activation_trace.role: A fixed seat supplies one localized access strategy.
A lookout place or watched path places that strategy inside a route-control image.
Extended paths supply the multiple routes among which the speakers are divided.
Differentiated paths and parties sharpen the plurality of possible routes.
Failure to outstrip or escape pursuit removes route plurality as an evasion mechanism.
Frightened flight supplies the attempted exit that remains unavailable.
The repeated act of finding links the focus encounter to the later inability to find shelter.
Protection within another's guarantee supplies the protection explicitly unavailable from the controlling power.
Inclining toward a refuge supplies the lateral hiding place that cannot be found.

structural_cues: 72:11-12 moves from divided paths to inability to escape; 72:22 repeats أجد while denying any refuge apart from God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies route plurality, failed escape, repeated finding, denied protection, and no refuge; I infer a jurisdiction spanning the alternatives rather than one blocked celestial seat. The divided paths may primarily be moral communities, and 72:22 speaks in the messenger's voice, so the spatial integration remains abductive.

changed_reading.before: One former listening location has become dangerous.
changed_reading.after: The listening post is a checkpoint inside route-wide containment: changing path, fleeing, or seeking a side refuge does not evade the governing access rule.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same hearing field leads to opposite outcomes: present interception meets a flame, whereas hearing guidance leads to heart-settling assent and freedom from overpowering burden. The decisive difference shifts from auditory ability to the listener's relation to the communicated guidance.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance expose the semantic stakes within the focus act of listening.
The bright flame supplies the outcome of the interceptive listening conditional.
Understanding and compliance supply the receptive hearing that produces a changed commitment.
Gentle direction toward road and truth supplies the object and orientation of receptive hearing.
Heart-settling assent supplies the response paired with hearing guidance.
Overtaking and overpowering supply the burden from which believing reception is declared secure.

structural_cues: 72:9 and 72:13 both use فَمَن conditionals, but the former begins with listening now and the latter with believing after hearing guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel conditionals, hearing guidance, assent, and absence of overpowering burden; I infer that mode and object of reception determine the divergent outcome. The parallel may be rhetorical rather than a formal taxonomy of permitted and forbidden hearing.

changed_reading.after: Listening bifurcates: extractive access triggers the guarded flame, while receptive hearing of guidance matures into trust and security.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus route yields bright fire, while steadfastness on the path yields abundant water that itself becomes a test. Fire and water are therefore not a simple punishment/reward pair; they are different regulated exposures attached to different orientations within one testing order.

activation_trace.role: Fixed seats supply the interceptive route's stable access posture.
A bright flame supplies the medium encountered on that route.
An extended path supplies the alternative route on which conduct is tested.
Straightness and balanced alignment supply the posture required on that path.
Water supplies the contrasting material exposure granted on the straight path.
Abundance of water and provision intensifies that exposure beyond mere survival.
Testing metal or persons prevents abundant water from collapsing into an uncomplicated reward.

structural_cues: 72:16-17 binds straightness on the path to abundant water and immediately states that the water is a test.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an interceptive station with flame and a straight path with abundant water-as-test; I infer a material contrast between route-conditioned exposures. A live alternative is that the water concerns provision alone and has no intended relation to the focus flame.

changed_reading.before: The flame is simply a punitive object at a celestial location.
changed_reading.after: The flame participates in a wider route-sensitive testing order in which different orientations meet different media, and even abundance remains examinational.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus listeners sit covertly to take in speech; later the servant stands to call openly while a crowd piles around him. Posture and information direction reverse together: seated intake is blocked, standing proclamation remains the visible authorized act.

activation_trace.role: Sitting in ambush supplies the covert receptive posture.
Meaningful uptake supplies the inward information direction sought by the seated listeners.
Bodily standing supplies the opposed public posture of the servant.
Calling and drawing by speech supplies the outward direction of proclamation.
A dense mass piled together supplies the public social pressure gathered around that call.

structural_cues: 72:9 pairs sitting with listening in; 72:19 pairs standing with calling out and a gathered mass.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversed postures, reversed speech direction, and crowding; I infer a contrast between covert appropriation and overt proclamation. Standing may be idiomatic and the crowd's stance is unspecified, so this remains a spatial-social activation rather than a syntactic claim.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely describes where the listeners positioned themselves.
changed_reading.after: Their seated posture marks covert intake in contrast with the servant's standing, outward, publicly contested transmission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unseen remains concealed by default but is disclosed to an approved messenger whose delivery is guarded. The same watch-root that confronts the focus listener later protects the authorized channel, converting the focus from blanket closure into selective access control.

activation_trace.role: Meaningful uptake supplies the information access being regulated.
Watching and guarding supply the exclusionary side of the focus access rule.
Delivering a message supplies the authorized function that must reach recipients.
Messenger and message supply the selected transmission channel.
Concealment from eyes supplies the protected information domain.
Emergence and disclosure supply the controlled operation performed on that concealed domain.
Approval supplies the selection criterion for the recipient messenger.
Watching and guarding now supply protection around the approved transmission rather than pursuit of an interceptor.

structural_cues: 72:26 states non-disclosure of the unseen, 72:27 introduces an exception for an approved messenger, and رصد recurs around that messenger.
The focus and 72:27 reuse the same final form رصدًا on opposite sides of the access boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies default concealment, selective disclosure, an approved messenger, delivery, and guarding; I infer one access-control system with exclusionary and protective modes. The two رصد occurrences could describe distinct operations without requiring a single technical system.

changed_reading.before: The guards seal hidden knowledge against every hearer.

strongest_changes: The focus is not anti-hearing in general: the surah contrasts blocked interception with recitation that is heard, guides, and produces assent.
The singular waiting flame is the individualized response of the saturated guard field introduced in 72:8.
The repeated رصد in 72:27 reverses the guard's relation to transmission: it repels an interceptor but protects an approved messenger.
The closing encompassing and enumeration cues extend the boundary from deterrence into monitored, accountable delivery.
summary.what_was_special: The focus already contains a watcher/counter-watcher symmetry and a former-versus-now protocol switch. Context repeatedly reverses its key relations: intercepted hearing becomes receptive hearing, sitting becomes standing proclamation, a blocked station becomes a straight tested path, and hostile-looking guard becomes protection for selected disclosure.
remaining_uncertainties: 72:10 may limit inference about consequences on earth without limiting inference about the immediate defensive function of the flame.
The route, fire-water, and sitting-standing integrations are coherent but may be thematic analogies rather than intended local syntax.
The severing and exposure outliers depend on non-dominant or branch-distant images and should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Former listening seats become exposed ambush sites.** The repeated ق ع د in `نقعد/مقاعد` activates B001, settled sitting, and B005, sitting in watch or ambush; the repeated س م ع activates B001, hearing, while `يجد` activates و ج د B001, finding; `شهابا` activates ش ه ب B002, bright flame; and `رصدا` activates ر ص د B001-B003, watching guard and lookout post. The temporal contrast `كنا ... الآن` holds the locations steady while reversing who watches whom. The inferred arrow is that a station designed for covert reception has itself become a monitored target. The ayah reads as surveillance reversal, not merely loss of access.

2. **Listening is separated from compliant hearing.** س م ع B003 can mean understanding and compliance, but here `يستمع` is followed by interception, whereas 72:1-2 joins hearing to guidance and faith. The packet supplies two listening channels with opposite outcomes; the inferred distinction is authorization rather than sound quality. This ayah therefore sharpens the surah’s hearing vocabulary: attentive reception can be illicit extraction or transformative compliance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The return of `رصدا` in 72:27 is the decisive surprise: identical watching vocabulary blocks unauthorized listeners here but protects authorized disclosure there, making access-status the causal distinction.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A listening practice had become fixed infrastructure.** Fixed `ق ع د` B001 is sitting and being set in a place; its verb/noun repetition in `نَقْعُدُ ... مَقَاعِدَ` turns repeated conduct into designated stations. `كُنَّا` (`ك و ن` B001, temporal predication) and `ٱلْآنَ` frame a before/now discontinuity, while the many `طَرَائِقَ` of 72:11 and two classes of 72:14 show that stable positions need not be legitimate ones. The packet supplies seats, temporal reversal, and later differentiated courses; I infer that routine access had naturalized one route among alternatives. The clause reads as the disclosure of an institution, not an incidental act of eavesdropping.

2. **The listening seat reverses into the ambush site.** Fixed `ق ع د` B005 is sitting in watch or ambush, and fixed `ر ص د` B001 is watching or lying in wait, with B003 the path or place where the watcher sits. Before `ٱلْآنَ`, the speakers occupy the watching posts; after it, an interceptor waits for each listener. The packet supplies the same spatial posture on both sides; I infer the reversal that unauthorized observers become the observed object. `مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ` now reads retrospectively as exposure points.

3. **A prepared response is individually attached.** Fixed `ر ص د` B002 is something prepared or set aside for someone. The conditional singular `فَمَن ... يَجِدْ لَهُ` assigns fixed `شِهَابًا` (`ش ه ب` B002, bright flame or firebrand) to whoever performs the act, while 72:12 denies escape and 72:13 removes fear from a different kind of hearing. The packet supplies conditional action, beneficiary/adversative `لَهُ`, prepared response, and contrasting outcomes; I infer a rule-based rather than random interception. The ending reads as per-attempt enforcement.

4. **Hearing divides into extraction and receptive compliance.** Fixed `س م ع` B001 covers hearing and attentive listening, while B003 is understanding, accepting, and acting. Here hearing is pursued from a stationary access point; in 72:13, `سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ` immediately yields `ءَامَنَّا`, and 72:14 yields a searched-out right course. The packet supplies the shared root and opposite sequences; I infer that outcome distinguishes acquisitive listening from compliant hearing. The fixed `لِلسَّمْعِ` reads as a purpose that can remain merely extractive even when attention is intense.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 72:27 reuses fixed `ر ص د` B001/B002 around the approved messenger, reversing the same prepared watch from ambush into protective escort. This makes channel legitimacy, not listening or hidden identity by itself, the decisive variable. The final delivery audit in 72:28 also confirms that observation serves accountable transmission, whereas the fixed seats sought information without an authorized relay.

baseline.text: Dinlemek için oradaki oturma yerlerine otururduk. Ama şimdi kim dinlemeye kalksa kendisini pusuda bekleyen bir alev bulur.

findings.text: Oturma fiiliyle oturma yerinin tekrarı, gizli dinlemeyi rastlantısal bir eylemden yerleşik bir erişim altyapısına dönüştürür.
Eskiden gözlem yapanların yerleri şimdi onların izlendiği pusu noktalarına dönüşür; böylece gözetimin yönü tersine çevrilir.
Her yeni dinleme girişimine hazırlanmış bir alevin bağlanması, müdahalenin rastlantısal değil, girişim başına işleyen bir kural olduğunu gösterir.
72:1 ve 72:13 ile karşılaştırma, dikkatli işitmeyi ikiye ayırır: burada yetkisiz bilgi çekme, orada anlayıp uymaya dönüşen yetkili kabul vardır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Seekers approach an upper listening ground as hunters, but the defended boundary converts their observation post into a prepared ambush against them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sky defense is assembled from reconnaissance, stalking, blinds, snares, prepared stations, and projectile force, making the listeners both hunters and hunted.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The listening blind is itself trapped
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A watcher sits in concealment to intercept sound, but the route and station have already been prepared as an ambush and snare.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Sitting, watching, and listening define a concealed observation post. The trap branches reverse its direction: the same route on which the listener waits is a prepared capture point, and the hunter's blind becomes the defender's snare. This role reversal explains the abrupt replacement of access by interception without reducing the scene to generic "security."

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: Sky Listening Becomes a Reversed Hunt
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Seekers approach an upper listening ground as hunters, but the defended boundary converts their observation post into a prepared ambush against them.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sky defense is assembled from reconnaissance, stalking, blinds, snares, prepared stations, and projectile force, making the listeners both hunters and hunted.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A bright projectile performs the interception
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The defended post launches a brilliant moving flame with the force of a combatant or charge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: brilliant flame or falling meteor (`quranic:root_000821:B002/m01`); warrior advancing in battle (`quranic:root_000821:B003/m01`); mixed light and darkness on the projectile (`quranic:root_000821:B001/m01`); flying sparks (`quranic:root_000787:B003/m01`); cutting and scattering under impact (`quranic:root_000787:B004/m01`); a forceful charge (`quranic:root_000782:B003/m01`); a group rising to battle (`quranic:root_001532:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The interceptor combines optical, thermal, and martial roles. Its mixed brightness gives it visible form, sparks supply dispersing fragments, and charge and warrior imagery give it directed agency. The flame is therefore not scenery around the guard system but the system's moving strike.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1: A Community Is Sorted into Cuts, Tracks, and Measured Alignment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective difference is materialized as longitudinal cuts and traversable tracks, then evaluated by whether a course is straight, balanced, or structurally warped.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Social and moral differentiation becomes a fabrication process: material is cut into strips, laid as routes, checked against a straight measure, and rejected as crooked dry stock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Deviant structure becomes dry combustible stock
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A course that bends away from the true line is embodied as warped or desiccated limbs and finally assigned the role of gathered fuel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deviation from the equitable line (`quranic:root_001224:B002/m01`); bent or rigid legs (`quranic:root_001224:B005/m01`); constricted provision (`quranic:root_001224:B010/m01`); gathered firewood (`quranic:root_000335:B001/m01`); a body dried like timber (`quranic:root_000335:B004/m01`); airborne sparks (`quranic:root_000787:B003/m01`); a white barren season (`quranic:root_000821:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The q-s-t contrast moves from moral deviation to bodily geometry: the line is bent, the limbs stiffen, provision contracts, and the result resembles dry timber. Firewood then ceases to be an arbitrary punishment image; it is the material endpoint of a warped and desiccated course.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak deyimi, ayakta durmanın karşıtı olan oturmayı, tek oturuşu, oturuş biçimini ve oturulan yeri birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdeği doğru yakalar; işten geri durma, pusu ve yapı temeli gibi başka dallar bu tanımın dışında tutulmalıdır.
